title: Experience at DynamicsCon 2025: Friends, Fun, and Learning
summary: A retrospective on attending DynamicsCon 2025, highlighting sessions on Business Central performance management, Power Pages, sales pricing, Power Automate, AI in AL Development, and Power BI, along with networking experiences and community engagement at the conference.
key_points: The author presented on Business Central Performance Management to over 40 attendees and shared presentation materials
Sessions covered multiple topics including Power Pages, Power Automate, Power BI, AI in AL Development, and new sales pricing features
MVP panels provided valuable insights and experienced perspectives on Business Central capabilities
The conference included networking events and social activities that fostered community connections
Security tracks and professional development opportunities were available for attendees seeking specialized knowledge

quotes.text: The MVP Panels are amazing, the amount of experience they are willing to share and the insight into Business Central is amazing.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the value of expert community engagement and peer learning at major conferences

quotes.text: You laughed/groaned at my Dad Jokes, asked some amazing questions, and I hope learned something new about BC Performance Management.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows that Business Central Performance Management was a key topic of focus and audience engagement
